notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Set Your Course For Alderaan, Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Prepared Defenses, Something Special Planned For Them, Mobilization Points and You Cannot Hide Forever; these count toward the 60. Total 60.

The strategy says to always start Mobilization Points and Something Special Planned For Them, with the third Effect varying by matchup (You Cannot Hide Forever is the example); no single starting Effect is named, so none is set.
The strategy says the deck went undefeated at his provincials (British Columbia, Canada) and helped him finish 3rd, missing the final by 3 differential; it says the deck was 11-1 in tournament play.
